# wordpress_wp_options_writing (Resource)

Manages WordPress Writing Settings through wp-admin. Requires user_auth credentials.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `default_category` (Number) Default post category ID.
- `default_email_category` (Number) Default category for posts sent by email.
- `default_post_format` (String) Default post format.
- `mailserver_login` (String) Mail server login.
- `mailserver_pass` (String, Sensitive) Mail server password.
- `mailserver_port` (Number) Mail server port.
- `mailserver_url` (String) Mail server hostname.
- `ping_sites` (String) URLs to notify when publishing a post.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
